# Copilot Instructions

Use `.agents` as the repository source of truth for AI-assisted development.

- Start with `.agents/README.md`.
- Follow `.agents/skills/common-agent-rules/SKILL.md` for all development, review, and testing work.
- Use task-specific skills from `.agents/skills` when they match the requested work.
- Keep suggestions minimal, project-consistent, and covered by relevant validation.

Do not duplicate durable rules in this adapter.
